items.title: Identify Rani Abbakka from the riddle
items.explanation: Rani Abbakka is a queen who led the fight for India's independence. She fought for her country and her right, carrying a shining sword in her hand with her son on her back in a cloth band, remembered as a warrior grand. She died defending her beloved Motherland.

items.title: Identify other women warriors
items.explanation: Women warriors who made significant contributions to India's struggle for Independence include: Indira Gandhi (who led the Indian National Congress and was assassinated in 1984), Mahatma Gandhi (led non-violent resistance), Subhas Chandra Bose (led the Quit India Movement), and Balasaheb Waghmare (a freedom fighter who died in a plane crash in 1945).
